evidence.observation: pressure_gauge not_installed; P is null throughout, but the growth stage requires the tube pressure gauge
Temperature followed the ramp setpoint; brief 760.1 °C overshoot at the start of growth, then held at 750 ±1 °C
Purge brought O2 down to about 12 ppm; 1.6–5.7 ppm during growth, so no sign of air getting in
Ar flow near 100 sccm setpoint during growth (98.8–100.4)
Heater power steady at about 45% during growth, which is what holding 750 °C should need
